title: Counting bag with deterministic most-common ordering

crosscheck.reference: naive reference: entry-ordered list of present items, most_common by count groups

cases.name: v4:prompt_example
cases.code:
b = sol.CountingBag()
r = [b.add("x"), b.add("y"), b.add("x")]
r.append(b.most_common(2))
b.add("z"); b.add("z")
r.append(b.most_common(3))
r.append(b.discard("x")); r.append(b.discard("x"))
b.add("x")
r.append(b.most_common(3))
r.append(b.discard("q"))
r.append(b.distinct())
r.append(len(b))
result = r

r += [b.distinct(), len(b), b.most_common(1)]

cases.name: v4:reentry_forgets_old_moment
cases.code:
b = sol.CountingBag()
for it in ["p", "q", "r"]:
    b.add(it)
b.discard("p")
r = [b.distinct(), b.most_common(3)]
b.add("p")
r += [b.most_common(3), b.distinct(), len(b)]
b.add("p")
r.append(b.most_common(3))
result = r

cases.name: v4:mixed_types_and_state

b = sol.CountingBag()
for it in [1, "1", (2, 3), 1, (2, 3), None]:
    b.add(it)
r = [b.distinct(), len(b), b.count(1), b.count("1"), b.count((2, 3)), b.count(None)]
r.append(b.most_common(4))
result = r

cases.name: v4:large_random_sequence
cases.code:
import random
rnd = random.Random(0)
b = sol.CountingBag()
items = ["i%d" % i for i in range(40)]
log = []
for step in range(3000):
    it = rnd.choice(items)
    if rnd.random() < 0.55:
        log.append(b.add(it))
    else:
        log.append(b.discard(it))
    if step % 500 == 0:
        log.append([len(b), b.distinct(), b.most_common(5)])
result = [log, b.most_common(10), len(b), b.distinct()]
